description: Get one published event by exact slug from list_events or search, with dates, venue, organiser sources and exhibitor count. Unknown or unpublished slugs return a not-found error. By default the large exhibitor list is omitted; use list_exhibitors to filter and page booths, or include_exhibitors=true for the full list.

include_exhibitors.description: false (default) returns the event summary and exhibitor_count only. true adds the complete unpaginated exhibitor array, which can be large; prefer list_exhibitors for filtered pages.

slug.description: Exact event slug returned by list_events or search; copy it rather than guessing. Use the lowercase hyphenated identifier (1-120 characters), not a title or full URL.

name: get_event
title: Get event
